scope:
Paired decider queries on live frames of the 34 wars that took our original
capital in the 2026-11-18/19 live Deity games (6 players, Small Continents,
Online), on the declaration turn and, when later, the first turn an enemy
soldier stood within two tiles of the capital.

`threatened-capital-trains-its-shooters` is the only bit that varies. Each case
is a live run's own events.jsonl cut after the FIRST state row of turn N (the
board the seat saw at the start of its turn), replayed at turn N. Both arms run
one frozen `civvis_orders --resumed` built from the branch (profile ci), with
that run's own requested genome (why.log line 1 `forced`, each as `--with`);
the on arm adds `--with threatened-capital-trains-its-shooters`.

Read per arm, from the proposed orders: the production order(s) the arm gives
the original capital (the last one is the head it leaves), classified as a
shooter (a ranged land unit, no siege gun), walls, another military unit, or a
peacetime item (any other building, district, project or civilian unit); and
the gene's journal lines.

This records proposal activation on captured live input only. It does not
execute in Civ VI, replays one turn at a time from the live board, and makes no
claim that a city holds.
